about_the_game:
And a lot more...






The secret of Timberland features a variety of game-based interactions to increase the level of storytelling, such as:

  • Animation - animated backgrounds and characters
  • Mythology – many of the actions and creatures in the novel are taken from Western European mythology. Thanks to this, you will be able to learn a lot about an unknown culture, rituals and about the ancient evil that is fraught with Western European mythology
  • Drawing - the novel uses mostly black and white colors, which helps the player to fully immerse himself in the atmosphere and the dark world of Timberland
  • Gorgeous Semi-Realistic Art
  • User Choices - take control of Kira’s fate. You get to make important decisions about characters’ relationships, actions, and more. Be careful not to pick a wrong choice- everyone’s lives could be destroyed.
  • Multiple Endings - the novel will have three endings: bad, good and secret (more endings and an epilogue will be if you unlock it in the funding targets)
  • Romance - you will find a very intricate love polygon, the ends of which can not converge. Can you untangle the web of feelings of all the characters?
  • Time machine - by the progress of the game story, you will be able to go back in time to your favorite moments, just add that moment to the list and navigate here in any moment
  • Investigation system - find evidence of the missing children, but be patient and pay attention to the details; the most important clues may be the hardest to find! Every investigation will have an impact on game ending, and you will have limited time to solve your puzzles. Take a breath, and clear your mind for the mystery that awaits you!
  • 50k+ words of the visual novel story
  • Multiple view points in the story - at some points, story is changing it's viewpoint to another character, so the player can better understand and immerse into the completely different part of the game world

content_descriptors.notes: The Secret of Timberland contains mature themes and is intended for an older audience. Player discretion is advised. Specific warnings for this game include but are not limited to: horror, unwanted advances, violence, alcohol and tobacco references, strong language, and serious injury.

short_description: The secret of Timberland is an adventure horror novel that will immerse you in a dark world full of mysteries and dangers. You have to unravel all of the secrets that Timberland hides and save the main characters from mortal danger. But... can you do it?
supported_languages:
English*, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
